payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP where dp[i][j] stores max similarity score of substrings ending at positions i-1 and j-1, with transition: match adds 2, else max of reducing by 1 or restart at 0.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 2D DP table iterating over all i, j with state defined by current indices, computing optimal substring pairs. This is a straightforward dp_2d_state pattern.
